rationale: RTS-FRZ-000004 through 000006 are completed and reusable governance, execution-record, evidence-reference, proposal, verification, and promotion-rule assets exist. However, the GitHub survey found no committed corpus of at least three governed run outcomes linked to evidence, no baseline/candidate regression dataset, and no versioned promotion/rollback target. These are explicit trigger conditions for RTS-FRZ-000007, so implementation must not start yet. First collect a privacy-safe outcome corpus and define the comparison and human-approval contract.

queries: governed run outcome execution record evidence reference
outcome learning success failure classification regression
skill promotion rollback retirement human approval

assets.notes: Provides structured simulated-only execution results and canonical execution_record emission, but no persisted governed outcome corpus.
Proposal-only evolution and explicit human adoption boundary.
Requires linked logs and audit evidence before success is VERIFIED or replicated.
Asset Manifest identifies a safe JSONL reading pattern that ignores request text; source compatibility still requires inspection before implementation.
Asset Manifest identifies aggregate reporting without prompt exposure; source compatibility still requires inspection before implementation.
Defines evidence states, repeated-success gates, rollback/retirement paths, and governance approval.

gaps: No committed privacy-safe corpus of at least three governed run outcomes with linked evidence was found.
No canonical outcome_record, learning_proposal, regression_result, or promotion_decision schema exists.
No baseline/candidate skill dataset and no immutable rollback snapshot are defined.
The Asset Manifest locator for RTS-Skills verification-runner returned 404 and must be refreshed before reuse.
Dry-run success is SIMULATED_ONLY and cannot be treated as verified real-world success.

risks: Synthetic or dry-run results could be mislabeled as verified outcomes.
Small or biased samples could promote a regression as a skill improvement.
Promotion without an immutable rollback snapshot could make recovery non-reconstructable.
Private prompts, customer data, provider payloads, or repository bodies could leak into learning records.
A proposal engine could accidentally acquire self-approval or mutation authority.
